audit.notes: Art-signature overlay (艺术签名); white text bottom-left over the photo — signature line, model, then location·time — per the official preview card (picker_overview.jpg 艺术签名 thumbnail: Photographer / iQOO 12 / 河北省 承德市 2023.11.22 21:44, bottom-left anchored) and temp.json mappings (签名 + logo + 时间 + 地点). In-photo placement, no band. The band box is sized tight with inner margins so the content anchors bottom-left instead of being re-centred by the overflow-fit pass.
unsupported: the signature line is the user handwriting (pref_camera_watermark_signature_type) — the vendor card shows the user name in script; no fixed glyph ships, so the frame + model + time·location render and the signature line only appears when the user supplies custom text
signature opacity (10-100%) and 3-step size scale not modelled
